The Visual state uses the available target pane as a clean, centered document canvas with stable margins and no competing source pane, clipping, or obstruction.
The visible document structure is legible, and the Method selection in the adjacent outline corresponds to the clearly visible Method section in the visual document.
Source is explicitly selected in blue; the host-editor action is separately labeled, and visual insertion/formatting commands are visibly dimmed while source-relevant controls remain clear.
The source editor occupies the full target workspace with readable monospace content, consistent margins, and no misleading preview or competing editing surface.

The source visibly contains the same Research notes, Method, Results, and Review checklist structure shown in the companion Visual state, with the selected Research notes outline entry matching the first source heading.

Split remains explicitly selected, while the pane labels clearly distinguish Markdown source from the read-only preview and preserve a single visible editing authority.

criteria.evidence: The toolbar visibly marks Split in blue, while the panes are explicitly labeled “Source (Markdown)” and “Preview (Read only).” The source is the sole editing surface, and “Open in VS Code” remains a separately labeled host-editor action.

The target render shows a clean, approximately equal-width side-by-side division with a crisp central divider, consistent pane headers, generous usable space, and no clipping or obstruction of either target pane.

The source and preview visibly contain the same revised document details, including the added Status column, Follow-up row, updated checklist item, and live-edit sentence. The selected “Review checklist” heading is highlighted in the source and matched by a blue-edged gray cue on the same preview heading.
Split remains explicitly selected in the compact mode control. “Source (Markdown)” and “Preview (Read only)” clearly distinguish the editable and read-only regions in the stacked layout.

At 480 px, the panes reflow vertically rather than becoming cramped columns. Each pane retains a full-width header and readable content area, with the preview beginning below the source and no horizontal clipping in the target.

The highlighted “Research notes” source heading corresponds to the blue-edged gray highlight on the preview’s “Research notes” heading. Both labels and the shared document content remain legible in the stacked state.
